description: Pre-deployment candidate acceptance gate criteria for AgroVision AI 2.0 disease detection models. All quantitative thresholds are provisional and subject to empirical validation on real-world multi-season field trials.

hard_gates.description: Model checkpoint must reload successfully in a completely isolated fresh Python process without relying on active training state.
hard_gates.requirement: Clean deserialization without errors or unhandled warnings.

hard_gates.description: Inference outputs must contain strictly finite real numbers (no NaNs, no Infs) under all valid image inputs.
Output tensor shape must exactly match the documented class mapping length.
Every model output index must map 1-to-1 to a valid canonical disease ID in Phase 2 disease_registry.json without ambiguous string labels.
hard_gates.requirement: 100% bijective mapping to canonical disease registry.

hard_gates.description: Inference image preprocessing (resolution, color channels, normalization range) must identically mirror the training pipeline.
hard_gates.requirement: RGB channels, 224x224 dimensions, verified scaling range.

hard_gates.description: Model must be evaluated strictly on the approved held-out test manifest with zero duplicate-group or patient-level overlap with training data.

strategy_b_crop_specific.note: Cross-crop confusion is 0.0% by structural design because the output space contains only host-supported diseases.

safety_and_robustness_criteria.description: When an unsupported crop image is presented, the system must trigger abstention (unsupported_crop or crop_mismatch) rather than returning a high-confidence false diagnosis.
safety_and_robustness_criteria.acceptable_behavior: Engine reports unsupported_crop with referral to extension clinic.

safety_and_robustness_criteria.description: When an incompatible plant organ is evaluated, evidence fusion must down-weight candidate scores or trigger organ_mismatch.
Performance on major staple food-security crops (Rice, Wheat, Tomato, Potato) must not degrade compared to the production baseline.
safety_and_robustness_criteria.acceptable_behavior: Delta macro F1 >= -0.02 across core food crops.
